body.x: Daegu Techno Park (Director Kwon Eop, www.ttp.org, hereafter Daegu TP) Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC, Center Director Choi Seok-kwon) prepared the joint pavilion and participated in “CES 2016”, the world’s largest IT electronics and tech exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.
(Picture description: A scene at Daegu TP MTCC’s joint pavilion at CES 2015)
The joint pavilion is located in Westgate Hotel, and a total of 27 companies from Daegu TP’s MTCC, DIP, and Kyungpook National University’s smart venture school are set to participate in the event.

From MTCC, RNWARE and SOSO in the next-generation embedded system industry; Taewon Innovation, EGIS, NINEONE, and 4DCULTURE in the ultra-wide 3D convergence industry; six companies, including DEVICEMALL, Goonies, DOIC, Quantumgames, HNK, and 3.14, in the creative-factory support business; and Huins, DROGEN, Erap Korea, and HYOSUNG TECHNOLOGY in the infrastructure project of smart drone application technology for security and convenience services are participating in the exhibition and showcasing their latest technologies.

Six companies from DIP, including NanoIT, Network Korea, Passion and Opus, IT HEALTH, GREEN SYSTEM, and U-HANPRESEN, and five companies from the smart venture school Kyungpook National University, including Seon Electronics, The Well, A-WORKS, GOQUAL, and QODE Interactive, are participating in the exhibition.

RNWARE will showcase the smart wireless image transmission device “ANYSYNC Full HD”, and SOSO will introduce products for brainwave signals and the software “BRAINNO”. Also set to be showcased at the exhibition are Taewon Innovation’s 3D-view production platform “Appeallook”, EGIS’ 3D GIS engine “XDWORLD”, NINEONE’s IoT-based brick “Smart Toy”, and 4DCULTURE’s 3D laser scanner and modular robot “MONABOT”.

Moreover, DEVICEMALL’s Portable and Rechargeable Customized Generator, Goonies’ digital device for art education “Smart Pallete”, DOIC’s gesture recognition-based educational content “Wizard of OZ for Kinect”, and Quantumgames’ “Screen Baseball System” will also be introduced.

HNK will showcase the automatic hand drip coffee machine “Baridios”, and 3.14 will unveil the moving paper toy “KamiBot” to the global market. Huins’ “Blueye Drone”, DROGEN’s “LOBIT320” and “LOBIT300”, Erap Korea’s drones for image shooting, and HYOSUNG TECHNOLOGY’s micro radar sensor module “HST-S1” will also be introduced.

Seon Electronics’ IoT-based automatic pet feeder “Karmi2”, The Well’s plant-based emotional community “TORYNET”, A-WORKS’ Smart home networking remote control “A-REMOTE”, GOQUAL’s smart light control switch “BlueSwitch”, and QODE Interactive’s “4D IoT Smart Table” will be unveiled.
One MTCC official said: “27 companies participated in this CES 2016 to promote Korea’s outstanding IT and mobile technology to the global market.”
“This is expected to create an opportunity for companies to establish a bridgehead for advancing into foreign markets.”

MTCC is supporting related domestic companies’ participation in domestic and international exhibitions, promoting the mobile business. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market, in order to take the lead in the technological innovation of the ICT and mobile convergence industry.

“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics industry. Various up-to-date technologies, including IoT, smart health, next-generation TVs, flexible displays, smart cars, and autonomous driving, will be shown at “CES 2016”.
